name: Sodium 0.9.4-beta.1 for Fabric 26.3
changelog:
Sodium 0.9.4-beta.1 is a followup release to Sodium 0.9.3 and includes bug fixes.

- Fixed rare cases of missing terrain when using spherical render distance and moving very rapidly

name: Sodium 0.9.3 for NeoForge 26.3
changelog: Sodium 0.9.3 adds the option to use spherical render distance and appropriate fog. Additionally, we've implemented a number of bug fixes and minor improvements. The release now includes constraints for NeoForge to prevent launching in broken configurations. Vanilla graphics options are now automatic
